fr: Petit à petit, l'oiseau fait son nid
say: puh-tee tah puh-tee, lwah-zoh feh sohn nee
lit: Little by little, the bird builds its nest.
en: Slow and steady wins the race. / Rome wasn't built in a day.

fr: Qui vivra verra
say: kee vee-vrah vair-ah
lit: Whoever lives will see.
en: Time will tell.

fr: L'habit ne fait pas le moine
say: lah-bee nuh feh pah luh mwahn
lit: The habit doesn't make the monk.
en: Don't judge a book by its cover.

fr: Mieux vaut tard que jamais
say: myuh voh tar kuh zhah-meh
lit: Better late than never.
en: Better late than never.

fr: Après la pluie, le beau temps
say: ah-preh lah plwee, luh boh tahn
lit: After the rain, fine weather.
en: Every cloud has a silver lining. / Things will get better.

fr: Quand le chat n'est pas là, les souris dansent
say: kahn luh shah neh pah lah, lay soo-ree dahns
lit: When the cat isn't there, the mice dance.
en: When the cat's away, the mice will play.

fr: Il ne faut pas vendre la peau de l'ours avant de l'avoir tué
say: eel nuh foh pah vahn-druh lah poh duh loors ah-vahn duh lah-vwahr too-ay
lit: Don't sell the bear's skin before you've killed it.
en: Don't count your chickens before they hatch.

fr: Qui ne risque rien n'a rien
say: kee nuh reesk ryan nah ryan
lit: Whoever risks nothing has nothing.
en: Nothing ventured, nothing gained.

fr: Pierre qui roule n'amasse pas mousse
say: pyair kee rool nah-mahss pah mooss
lit: A rolling stone gathers no moss.
en: A rolling stone gathers no moss.

fr: Tout vient à point à qui sait attendre
say: too vyan tah pwan ah kee seh tah-tahn-druh
lit: Everything comes in good time to whoever knows how to wait.
en: Good things come to those who wait.

fr: Il n'y a pas de fumée sans feu
say: eel nyah pah duh foo-may sahn fuh
lit: There's no smoke without fire.
en: Where there's smoke, there's fire.

fr: Vouloir, c'est pouvoir
say: voo-lwahr, say poo-vwahr
lit: To want is to be able.
en: Where there's a will, there's a way.

fr: Loin des yeux, loin du cœur
say: lwan day zyuh, lwan doo kur
lit: Far from the eyes, far from the heart.
en: Out of sight, out of mind.

fr: C'est en forgeant qu'on devient forgeron
say: say tahn for-zhahn kohn duh-vyan for-zhuh-rohn
lit: It's by forging that you become a blacksmith.
en: Practice makes perfect.

fr: Les murs ont des oreilles
say: lay moor ohn day zoh-ray
lit: The walls have ears.
en: Careful, someone might be listening.

fr: Il faut battre le fer pendant qu'il est chaud
say: eel foh bah-truh luh fair pahn-dahn keel eh shoh
lit: You must strike the iron while it's hot.
en: Strike while the iron is hot.

fr: Une hirondelle ne fait pas le printemps
say: oon ee-rohn-del nuh feh pah luh pran-tahn
lit: One swallow doesn't make spring.
en: One good sign doesn't mean it's all good yet.

fr: Ce n'est pas la mer à boire
say: suh neh pah lah mair ah bwahr
lit: It's not like drinking the sea.
en: It's not that hard. / It's not the end of the world.

fr: Qui se ressemble s'assemble
say: kee suh ruh-sahm-bluh sah-sahm-bluh
lit: Those who are alike come together.
en: Birds of a feather flock together.

fr: La nuit porte conseil
say: lah nwee port kohn-say
lit: The night brings advice.
en: Sleep on it.

fr: Il ne faut pas mettre la charrue avant les bœufs
say: eel nuh foh pah meh-truh lah shah-roo ah-vahn lay buh
lit: Don't put the plow before the oxen.
en: Don't put the cart before the horse.

fr: Rira bien qui rira le dernier
say: ree-rah byan kee ree-rah luh dair-nyay
lit: He laughs well who laughs last.
en: He who laughs last laughs best.
